name: Barbell Curl
steps: Stand tall holding the bar at your thighs, palms up, hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows by your sides and curl the bar up to your chest.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight, without swinging your body.

name: EZ Bar Curl
steps: Hold the EZ bar on the angled grips, palms up, arms hanging straight.
Pin your elbows to your sides and curl the bar towards your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to the start.

name: Close-Grip EZ Bar Curl
steps: Hold the EZ bar on the inner bends, palms up, hands close together.
Keep your elbows still and curl the bar up to your upper chest.
Lower it under control until your arms are straight again.

name: Wide-Grip EZ Bar Curl
steps: Hold the EZ bar on the outer bends, palms up, arms straight.
Keep your elbows at your sides and curl the bar to your chest.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully straight.

name: Close-Grip Barbell Curl
steps: Hold the bar palms up with your hands narrower than shoulder-width.
Keep your elbows tucked in and curl the bar up to your chest.
Lower it slowly to your thighs without leaning back.

name: Wide-Grip Barbell Curl
steps: Hold the bar palms up with your hands wider than your shoulders.
Keep your elbows at your sides and curl the bar to your chest.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Barbell Drag Curl
steps: Stand holding the bar against your thighs, palms up, shoulder-width grip.
Pull your elbows back and drag the bar up your body to your chest.
Keep the bar touching you as you lower it back down.

name: Barbell Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at the preacher bench with the backs of your arms on the pad.
Hold the bar palms up and curl it towards your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight, without dropping the weight.

name: EZ Bar Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at the preacher bench, armpits snug against the top of the pad.
Hold the EZ bar on the angled grips and curl it up.
Lower it slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

name: Barbell Spider Curl
steps: Rest your chest on the steep side of a preacher or incline bench.
Let the bar hang with straight arms, palms up.
Curl the bar up without moving your elbows, then lower it slowly.

name: EZ Bar Spider Curl
steps: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, arms hanging straight with the EZ bar.
Curl the bar towards your forehead, keeping your upper arms still.
Squeeze, then lower slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Barbell 21s
steps: Do 7 half curls from your thighs up to elbow height.
Do 7 half curls from elbow height up to your chest.
Finish with 7 full curls, then log the set as 21 reps.

name: Plate Curl
steps: Hold a weight plate by its sides, arms straight down in front of you.
Keep your elbows at your sides and curl the plate up to your chest.
Lower it slowly back to your thighs.

name: Dumbbell Curl
steps: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows at your sides and curl both dumbbells to your shoulders.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight again.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms forward.
Curl one dumbbell to your shoulder while the other arm stays still.
Lower it slowly and repeat with the other arm; both arms make one rep.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Curl
steps: Hold one dumbbell at your side, palm forward, free hand on your hip.
Curl the dumbbell to your shoulder, keeping your elbow by your side.
Lower slowly, finish all reps, then switch arms.

name: Seated Dumbbell Curl
steps: Sit tall on a bench, a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging down.
Curl both dumbbells up, turning your palms to face your shoulders.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Hammer Curl
steps: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your thighs.
Keep your palms facing in and curl both dumbbells to your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Alternating Hammer Curl
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Curl one dumbbell up with your thumb on top, the other arm still.
Lower it and switch arms; both arms make one rep.

name: Single-Arm Hammer Curl
steps: Hold one dumbbell at your side, palm facing your thigh.
Curl it to your shoulder with your thumb pointing up.
Lower slowly, finish all reps, then switch arms.

name: Seated Hammer Curl
steps: Sit tall on a bench, a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Curl both dumbbells up with your thumbs on top.
Lower them slowly until your arms hang straight.

name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
steps: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your thighs.
Curl one dumbbell across your body towards the opposite shoulder.
Lower it and repeat with the other arm; both arms make one rep.

name: Concentration Curl
steps: Sit on a bench, feet wide, and rest your elbow inside your thigh.
Curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder without moving your upper arm.
Lower slowly, finish all reps, then switch arms.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
steps: Sit back on a bench set to about 45 degrees, arms hanging straight down.
Keep your elbows pointing down and curl the dumbbells, together or in turns.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully straight.

name: Incline Hammer Curl
steps: Sit back on an incline bench, dumbbells hanging down, palms facing in.
Curl both dumbbells up with your thumbs on top, elbows still.
Lower slowly until your arms hang straight.

name: Dumbbell Spider Curl
steps: Lie chest-down on an incline bench, a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
Curl both dumbbells up without moving your upper arms.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly to straight arms.

name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at the preacher bench, a dumbbell in each hand, arms on the pad.
Curl both dumbbells up towards your shoulders, palms facing you.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight, without dropping the weight.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Preacher Curl
steps: Rest the back of one arm on the preacher pad, dumbbell in hand.
Curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder, palm facing you.
Lower slowly to nearly straight, finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: Incline Bench Preacher Curl
steps: Stand behind an incline bench and drape one arm over the backrest.
Curl the dumbbell up with your upper arm pressed on the pad.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: Preacher Hammer Curl
steps: Sit at the preacher bench, a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Keep your arms on the pad and curl the dumbbells up, thumbs on top.
Lower them slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

name: Zottman Curl
steps: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Curl both dumbbells up, then turn your palms to face down at the top.
Lower slowly with palms down, then turn them back up at the bottom.

name: Waiter Curl
steps: Hold one dumbbell upright, both palms flat under its top end.
Keep your elbows at your sides and curl it up to your chest.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Cable Curl
steps: Attach a short bar to the low pulley and hold it palms up.
Stand tall, elbows at your sides, and curl the bar to your chest.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight, keeping the cable tight.

name: Rope Cable Curl
steps: Attach a rope to the low pulley and hold an end in each hand.
Curl the rope up, turning your palms up and pulling the ends apart.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Rope Hammer Curl
steps: Attach a rope to the low pulley and hold it with palms facing in.
Keep your elbows at your sides and curl the rope to your chest.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Single-Arm Cable Hammer Curl
steps: Stand side-on to a low pulley holding a rope or handle, palm facing in.
Curl it up to your shoulder with your thumb on top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: Cable Preacher Curl
steps: Set a preacher bench in front of a low pulley with a short bar.
Rest your arms on the pad and curl the bar towards your face.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

name: Single-Arm Cable Preacher Curl
steps: Set a preacher bench before a low pulley and hold one handle.
Rest your arm on the pad and curl the handle to your shoulder.
Lower slowly to nearly straight, finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: Single-Arm Cable Curl
steps: Attach a handle to the low pulley and hold it palm up.
Keep your elbow by your side and curl the handle to your shoulder.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: Overhead Cable Curl
steps: Stand between two high pulleys, holding a handle in each hand.
With your arms out at shoulder height, curl the handles towards your ears.
Straighten your arms slowly, keeping your elbows level.

name: Single-Arm High Cable Curl
steps: Stand side-on to a high pulley and hold the handle, arm out straight.
Keep your elbow at shoulder height and curl the handle to your head.
Straighten slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: Behind-the-Back Cable Curl
steps: Face away from a low pulley, handle in one hand, arm slightly behind you.
Step forward until you feel a stretch, then curl the handle up.
Lower slowly to the stretch, finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: Cable Concentration Curl
steps: Sit or kneel by a low pulley with your elbow braced on your thigh.
Curl the handle up to your shoulder without moving your upper arm.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: Lying Cable Curl
steps: Lie on your back with your feet towards a low pulley, holding a bar.
Keep your elbows by your sides and curl the bar to your chest.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Preacher Curl
steps: Set the seat so your armpits sit at the top of the pad.
Grip the handles palms up and curl them towards your shoulders.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

name: Machine Bicep Curl
steps: Set the seat so your elbows line up with the machine's turning point.
Keep your upper arms on the pad and curl the handles up.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.

name: Triceps Pushdown
steps: Attach a short straight bar to a high pulley and grip it palms down.
Pin your elbows to your sides and push the bar down to your thighs.
Let the bar rise slowly to chest height without moving your elbows.

name: Rope Triceps Pushdown
steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley and hold an end in each hand.
Push the rope down to your thighs, pulling the ends apart at the bottom.
Let it rise slowly to chest height, elbows fixed at your sides.

name: V-Bar Triceps Pushdown
steps: Attach a V-bar to a high pulley and grip it palms down.
Keep your elbows tight to your sides and push the bar to your thighs.
Let it rise slowly to chest height.

name: Reverse-Grip Triceps Pushdown
steps: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and grip it palms up.
Keep your elbows at your sides and push the bar down to your thighs.
Let it rise slowly, stopping before your elbows move forward.

name: Single-Arm Cable Pushdown
steps: Attach a single handle to a high pulley and hold it palm down.
Elbow at your side, push the handle down until your arm is straight.
Let it rise slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: Single-Arm Reverse-Grip Pushdown
steps: Attach a handle to a high pulley and hold it palm up.
Keep your elbow at your side and push the handle down to your thigh.
Let it rise slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: Cable Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Attach a rope to a pulley, face away, and hold it behind your head.
Step one foot forward, elbows pointing ahead and close together.
Straighten your arms forward, then bend them slowly to stretch behind your head.

name: Single-Arm Overhead Cable Extension
steps: Attach a handle to the low pulley and stand with your back to it.
Hold the handle behind your head with your elbow pointing up.
Straighten your arm overhead, lower slowly, then switch arms after your reps.

name: Kneeling Cable Triceps Extension
steps: Kneel facing away from a high pulley, holding a rope behind your head.
Lean forward slightly with your elbows by your ears.
Straighten your arms forward, then bend them slowly back behind your head.

name: Incline Cable Triceps Extension
steps: Set an incline bench with its backrest facing a low pulley.
Lie back holding a short bar behind your head, elbows pointing up.
Straighten your arms overhead, then let the bar return slowly behind your head.

name: Cable Skull Crusher
steps: Lie on a flat bench, head towards a low pulley, holding a short bar.
With arms straight up, bend your elbows to lower the bar to your forehead.
Straighten your arms again without moving your elbows.

name: Lying Rope Triceps Extension
steps: Lie on a flat bench, head towards a low pulley, holding a rope.
Point your upper arms at the ceiling with the rope behind your head.
Straighten your arms up, then lower the rope slowly back behind your head.

name: Cable Triceps Kickback
steps: Hold a handle from a low pulley and lean forward with a flat back.
Keep your upper arm by your side and straighten your arm back.
Bend it slowly to the start, finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: Cross-Body Cable Extension
steps: Set a pulley at shoulder height and hold it with your far hand.
Start with your hand by the opposite shoulder, elbow bent.
Straighten your arm out to the side, return slowly, then switch arms.

name: Machine Triceps Extension
steps: Set the seat so your upper arms rest flat on the pad.
Push the handles down until your arms are straight.
Let them return slowly without lifting your elbows.

name: Bodyweight Triceps Extension
steps: Hold a fixed bar at waist height, body straight and leaning forward.
Bend your elbows to lower your head under the bar.
Push back up by straightening your arms.

name: Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands cupped under the top end.
Keep your elbows close to your head and lower it behind your head.
Straighten your arms to lift it back up.

name: Seated Overhead Dumbbell Extension
steps: Sit on a bench with back support, holding one dumbbell overhead in both hands.
Lower it behind your head, keeping your elbows pointing up.
Straighten your arms to press it back overhead.

name: Single-Arm Overhead Dumbbell Extension
steps: Sit or stand holding a dumbbell straight overhead in one hand.
Bend your elbow to lower it behind your head, upper arm still.
Straighten your arm, finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
steps: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head.
Straighten your arms again, keeping your upper arms still.

name: Single-Dumbbell Skull Crusher
steps: Lie on a flat bench holding one dumbbell above your chest with both hands.
Bend your elbows to lower it behind your head, upper arms still.
Straighten your arms to bring it back above your chest.

name: Single-Arm Lying Dumbbell Extension
steps: Lie on a flat bench holding one dumbbell straight above your shoulder.
Bend your elbow to lower the dumbbell beside your head.
Straighten your arm, finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: Incline Dumbbell Skull Crusher
steps: Lie back on an incline bench, dumbbells held straight up, palms facing in.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells behind your head.
Straighten your arms back up without moving your upper arms.

name: Decline Dumbbell Skull Crusher
steps: Lie on a decline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight up.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head.
Straighten your arms again, keeping your elbows pointing up.

name: Tate Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench, dumbbells held straight up, inner ends almost touching.
Bend your elbows out to the sides to bring the dumbbells to your chest.
Press them back up by straightening your arms.

name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
steps: Rest one knee and hand on a bench and keep your back flat.
Hold the dumbbell in your other hand, upper arm raised to your side.
Straighten your arm back, lower slowly, then switch arms after your reps.

name: Two-Arm Dumbbell Kickback
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and lean forward from your hips, back flat.
Keep your upper arms by your sides and straighten both arms back.
Bend your elbows slowly to return.

name: Barbell Skull Crusher
steps: Lie on a bench holding the bar above your chest, palms facing your feet.
Bend only your elbows to lower the bar to your forehead.
Straighten your arms to raise it, keeping full control near your face.

name: EZ Bar Skull Crusher
steps: Lie on a flat bench holding the EZ bar's inner bends above your chest.
Keep your upper arms still and lower the bar towards your forehead.
Straighten your arms to press it back up.

name: Behind-the-Head Skull Crusher
steps: Lie on a flat bench holding a bar or EZ bar above your chest.
Let your upper arms tilt back and lower the bar behind your head.
Straighten your arms to bring the bar back over your chest.

name: Incline Barbell Skull Crusher
steps: Lie back on an incline bench holding a bar overhead with a close grip.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar behind your head.
Straighten your arms back up without moving your elbows.

name: Decline EZ Bar Skull Crusher
steps: Lie on a decline bench with your feet hooked, EZ bar above your chest.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar towards your forehead.
Straighten your arms again, keeping your upper arms still.

name: JM Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench, bar over your chest, hands just inside shoulder-width.
Bend your elbows and let the bar travel down towards your chin.
Press it back up along the same path, elbows tucked in.

name: Standing Barbell Overhead Extension
steps: Stand tall holding a bar or EZ bar straight overhead, hands close.
Keep your elbows by your head and lower the bar behind it.
Straighten your arms to lift it back overhead.

name: Seated Barbell Overhead Extension
steps: Sit on a bench with back support, bar or EZ bar held overhead.
Lower it behind your head, elbows pointing up and close together.
Straighten your arms to press it back up.

name: Reverse-Grip Bench Press
steps: Lie on a flat bench and grip the bar palms facing you, shoulder-width.
Lower the bar slowly to your lower chest, elbows tucked in.
Press it back up; use a spotter, as this grip can slip.

name: Reverse Barbell Curl
steps: Hold the bar palms down, hands shoulder-width, arms straight.
Keep your elbows at your sides and curl the bar to your chest.
Lower slowly, keeping your wrists straight.

name: EZ Bar Reverse Curl
steps: Hold the EZ bar palms down on the angled grips, arms straight.
Curl the bar up to your chest, elbows at your sides.
Lower it slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Curl
steps: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing back.
Keep your palms down and curl both dumbbells to your shoulders.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Cable Reverse Curl
steps: Attach a straight bar to the low pulley and grip it palms down.
Keep your elbows at your sides and curl the bar to your chest.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Reverse Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at the preacher bench and grip an EZ bar or bar palms down.
Keep your arms on the pad and curl the bar up.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

name: Plate Reverse Curl
steps: Hold a weight plate by its edges, palms down, arms straight.
Keep your elbows at your sides and curl the plate up to your chest.
Lower it slowly to the start.

name: Barbell Wrist Curl
steps: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs, palms up, wrists past your knees.
Let the bar roll down to your fingers, then curl your wrists up.
Lower slowly, moving only your wrists.

name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
steps: Sit with a dumbbell in each hand, forearms on your thighs, palms up.
Lower the dumbbells by bending your wrists down.
Curl your wrists up as high as you can, then lower slowly.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Wrist Curl
steps: Rest one forearm on a bench, palm up, hand over the edge.
Lower the dumbbell by bending your wrist, then curl it up.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: Reverse Barbell Wrist Curl
steps: Sit with your forearms on your thighs, palms down, wrists past your knees.
Lift the backs of your hands up as high as you can.
Lower the bar slowly, moving only your wrists.

name: Reverse Dumbbell Wrist Curl
steps: Sit with a dumbbell in each hand, forearms on your thighs, palms down.
Raise the backs of your hands, bending only at the wrists.
Lower slowly to the start.

name: Behind-the-Back Wrist Curl
aliases: behind the back barbell wrist curl
steps: Stand holding a bar behind your back, palms facing back, arms straight.
Let the bar roll down to your fingers.
Curl it back up by bending your wrists, then repeat slowly.

name: Wrist Roller
steps: Hold the roller at shoulder height, arms straight out, weight on the floor.
Turn the handle hand over hand to wind the rope until the weight rises.
Unwind slowly to lower it; one full wind up and down is one rep.

name: Plate Pinch
steps: Press two plates together, smooth sides out, and pinch them with your fingertips.
Lift them and hold at your side with your arm straight.
Hold for time, then set them down with control; do both hands.

name: Hand Gripper
steps: Hold the gripper in one hand with the handle across your palm.
Squeeze until the handles touch, then let them open slowly.
Switch hands after your reps; log the gripper's rated kg as weight.
